description: Quick screen (windowed realized PnL, win rate, copyTradeScore, copyTradeGrade, bot, exchange, net-winner and dormant flags) for up to 10 Solana wallets in one paid call, ranked by realized PnL. Pass addresses comma-separated. Costs $0.015 USDC (15000 base units) via x402. The same price is charged for HTTP GET /wallet/quick/batch. An unpaid HTTP call returns 402 even when the query is missing or invalid. A signed call with invalid arguments is rejected before settlement and is not charged. A successful result can set cached, stale, and cacheAgeMs. stale true means a previous result was served while a refresh runs or the upstream failed. You are charged only when the tool result is not an error.

addresses.description: 1 to 10 comma-separated base58 Solana wallet addresses.
